verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing provides real-time authorization control via relayed authorisation webhooks and transaction rules (auto approve/decline based on custom logic and validation checks), plus card lifecycle actions to suspend/close a compromised card, and dispute webhooks for suspicious activity flagged by cardholders. However there's no evidence of network fraud scores or Adyen's own risk models being surfaced at auth time, no dedicated suspicious-activity alerting system, and no explicit card-reissue workflow beyond generic paymentInstrument creation. Missing for 10: network/own fraud score exposure at authorization, proactive suspicious-activity alerts, and documented reissue-after-compromise flow.
